name: Homestyle Carrot Cake with Walnuts & Cream Cheese (Triple Hazard Warning)
whyItWorks: Despite having 'carrots' in the name, traditional bakery carrot cake is a triple threat for IBD: shredded raw carrots that remain fibrous after baking, hard angular walnut chunks (stricture hazard), chewy raisins, and heavy vegetable oil + cream cheese frosting.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Extreme Trigger Warning: Avoid bakery carrot cake during flares and strictures. If desiring cake, choose fat-free angel food cake or plain vanilla sponge.
watchOuts: High fat, dense nuts, and dried raisins make this one of the most provocative desserts for IBD symptoms.
